description: A list of Vallis (sections) in the Taittiriya Upanishad, each containing multiple Anuvakas.

valli_name.description: The name of the Valli in Devanagari (e.g., शीक्षावल्ली).

valli_number.description: The sequential number of the Valli (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

anuvakas.description: A list of Anuvakas (chapters) within this Valli.

anuvaka_number.description: The sequential number of the Anuvaka within the Valli.

mantra_text.description: The original Taittiriya Upanishad Mantra text for this Anuvaka in Devanagari.

commentary_text.description: The complete Bhashya (commentary) text for this Anuvaka in Devanagari.
